definitions.gloss: bravery in battle; martial valor; military prowess
definitions.explanation: Courage and skill displayed in warfare or combat. Specifically refers to valor demonstrated through martial deeds.

examples.japanese: {武勇|ぶゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧。
examples.english: A military commander of outstanding valor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{武勇|ぶゆう}{伝|でん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{語|かた}り{継|つ}がれている→語り継ぐ：22312_kataritsugu⟧。
examples.english: Tales of his martial valor are still handed down today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦国|せんごく}{時代|じだい}→戦国時代：19200_sengokujidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{武勇|ぶゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{馳|は}せた→馳せる：10486_haseru⟧。
examples.english: During the Warring States period, many samurai who boasted martial valor made a name for themselves.

notes:
A literary word specifically about bravery in military or combat contexts. Combines {武|ぶ} (martial, military) and {勇|ゆう} (courage).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {武勇|ぶゆう}{伝|でん}: tales of valor; heroic exploits
- {武勇|ぶゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to be outstanding in martial valor
- {武勇|ぶゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧: to boast martial prowess
- {武勇|ぶゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to demonstrate bravery in battle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勇猛|ゆうもう}→勇猛：22154_yuumou⟧: brave and fierce — describes the quality of being both brave and aggressive
- ⟦{勇敢|ゆうかん}→勇敢：07637_yuukan⟧: brave; courageous — more general courage, not limited to military contexts
- ⟦{豪胆|ごうたん}→豪胆：22155_goutan⟧: bold; daring — emphasizes fearlessness rather than martial skill
- {武功|ぶこう}: military achievement — refers to specific accomplishments rather than the quality of bravery

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. Almost exclusively used in historical narratives, literature, and descriptions of samurai or military figures.
